high_level_description: The image depicts a circular emblem or badge mounted on a wall. The emblem is predominantly blue with a white shield at its center. The shield features a sunburst design in the middle, surrounded by three stars, one at each corner of the shield. Below the shield, there are two elephants facing each other, and above them, a small boat is positioned. The text "REPUBLIKA NG PILIPINAS" is inscribed along the bottom edge of the emblem, which translates to "Republic of the Philippines" in English. This suggests that the emblem represents the national emblem of the Philippines.
